iterations.title: Algebraic syntax
iterations.claim: Every instruction belongs to a closed opcode ADT.

iterations.title: Stack small-step semantics
iterations.claim: PUSH/POP preserve a typed stack invariant.

iterations.title: Probability simplex
iterations.claim: EMIT distributions are normalized nonnegative measures.

iterations.title: Fixed-point serialization
iterations.claim: Rational quantization has a finite byte representation.

iterations.title: Register plus stack state
iterations.claim: A machine configuration is an ADT, not an untyped blob.

iterations.title: Bounded reachability
iterations.claim: Finite horizon yields a terminating state enumeration.

iterations.title: Partition refinement
iterations.claim: Behavioral signatures merge exactly equivalent leaves.

iterations.title: Local TV certificate
iterations.claim: A stored emission approximation can be independently checked.

iterations.title: Horizon error transport
iterations.claim: Per-step TV error gives a conservative trajectory bound.

iterations.title: Top-k truncation
iterations.claim: Dropping residual mass exposes, rather than hides, approximation error.

iterations.title: Well-typed opcode sequence
iterations.claim: Malformed programs are rejected before execution.

iterations.title: FLAN artifact binding
iterations.claim: The compiler binds to a validated FLAN stack program.

iterations.title: Budget monotonicity
iterations.claim: Increasing top-k budget did not worsen measured maximum TV on the frontier.

iterations.title: Independent FLAN replay
iterations.claim: The serialized stack program rechecks against FLAN-T5.

iterations.title: End-to-end bounded theorem shape
iterations.claim: The result has a finite state set, finite distributions, and an explicit horizon.

interpretation: Tests establish finite executable invariants; they do not prove unrestricted FLAN equivalence.
